<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>My Book Collection</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: #e0e0e0;
            padding: 40px 20px;
        }
        
        .container {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        
        header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        
        h1 {
            font-size: 3em;
            color: #ffd700;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        .subtitle {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            color: #a0a0a0;
            font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .book-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 25px;
        }
        
        .book-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }
        
        .book-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2);
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.05);
        }
        
        .book-card h2 {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            color: #ffd700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        
        .book-card .author {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            color: #a0a0a0;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #a0a0a0;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta span {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta .date {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta .pages {
            color: #a0a0a0;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta .pages strong {
            color: #ffd700;
        }
        
        .book-card .meta .pages .pages {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-weight: bold;
